notes.title: Game Update 1.4 is live!
notes.content:
[img]http://ohnoo.com/images/steam/up14.jpg[/img]

Greetings everyone! 

We fixed some user reported bugs:
  [*]Critical and small bugs fixed
  [*]Animation improvements
  [*]Linguistic corrections in russian version
  [*]Puzzle mechanics improvements
  [*]Memory improvements
[/list]
Please do contact us if you encounter any issues. Either here on Steam or send a mail to contact@ohnoo.com

Thank you for supporting us by purchasing our game!    

OhNoo Team

notes.title: Our new game - Tsioque is on Kickstarter!
notes.content:
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ohnoo/tsioque-an-animated-2d-adventure-game][img]http://ohnoo.com/images/tsioque/tsioque_demo.jpg[/img][/url]

Dear adventure game fans,

I am pleased to inform you our next game - TSIOQUE - has just recently launched on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ohnoo/tsioque-an-animated-2d-adventure-game] Kickstarter.[/url].

If you liked Dragon's Lair, Day of the Tentacle or Ron Gilbert's Pajama Sam, then TSIOQUE is a title for you.  Expect darkness in humorous coating this time around, we hope you will like it.

Visit the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ohnoo/tsioque-an-animated-2d-adventure-game] Kickstarter[/url] page and don't forget to try the [url=https://www.facebook.com/OhNooStudio/posts/898175300247539/] demo![/url]

or if you like you can play the demo here on Steam: http://store.steampowered.com/app/393190/?snr=1_7_tabpaginated__222

- OhNoo Team

notes.title: Game Update 1.1 is live!
notes.content:
[img]http://ohnoo.com/images/steam/up11.jpg[/img]

Greetings everyone! 

We fixed some user reported bugs and we added 2 new languages.

[h1]Features:[/h1]
[list]
  [*]Turkish localization now available!
  [*]Brazilian-Portuguese localization now available!
[/list]
[h1]Changes:[/h1]
[list]
  [*]Fixed bugs in russian version
  [*]Fixed bugs in italian version
  [*]Fixed bugs in french version
  [*]Fixed an error “blacksmith's house bug” 
  [*]Fixed a rare ending glitch
  [*]Fixed Steam Overlay low framrate problem.
[/list]
We are currently finishing off the Hungarian and Portuguese translation and that should be available soon. 

Please do contact us if you encounter any issues. Either here on Steam or send a mail to contact@ohnoo.com

Thank you for supporting us by purchasing our game!    

OhNoo Team
